newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - Telebras target price raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Telebras target price raised.

text.p: -- ING Barings said in a report it was raising its year-end target price for Brazilian state-owned telecom company Telebras to $150 per ADR from $140.
-- Analyst Vera Rossi also maintained a buy recommendation for the company.
-- She said a rate rebalancing announced last week "demonstrated the political will of the government to move foward with the privatization process" and increased the company's competitiveness.
-- She also said the rate restructuring was "more aggressive than expected" and it represented an acceleration of the privatization process.
-- Telebras ADRs were down 3.25 points at $110.5.
